controller_string: not measured -- the `hw` CLI subcommand's handler (firestarter_app/firestarter/cli_handlers.py:969, `_build_op_flags()` called with zero kwargs) never forwards the CLI's -v/--verbose into the wire command's `flags` field, so FLAG_VERBOSE (0x80) is never set on the command `hw` sends; firmware's MSG_INFO_FW echo line (firestarter.cpp:150, FLAG_VERBOSE-gated per include/logging_id.h) is therefore never emitted by `hw`, regardless of CLI verbosity or which arm's firmware is running. Measured twice: pre-flash (this board's then-current firmware) and post-flash (the control arm, just-flashed) both via `firestarter -v -p /dev/ttyACM0 hw`, captured to logs/03_hw_probe_pre_flash.std{out,err}.log and logs/06_hw_probe_post_flash.std{out,err}.log -- neither shows an I:/INFO: FW line. This is a genuine host-app limitation, out of scope for this phase to fix (D-16 boundary: no product-code changes); every later cell's controller_string field (via capture_provenance.py's identical hw-based probe) will hit the same limitation until a future host-app fix forwards verbose into hw's wire flags.
